cover.title: 5 niche ways to become the european alternative chatgpt names

inner.title: unblock oai-searchbot
inner.body: openai says oai-searchbot is what surfaces sites in chatgpt search, while gptbot is only for training. a site that blocks the search bot won't appear in answers, and a fix takes about 24 hours.

inner.title: write a replaces line
inner.body: papermark's list of 100 european tools gives each one a replaces line naming the us product, plus a starting price. skip that line on your own page and nobody can match you to the question.

inner.title: name your data centre city
inner.body: european-alternatives.eu tags listings eu hosted, and papermark names hetzner's nuremberg, falkenstein and helsinki. most entries name no city, so the vague ones blur together.

inner.title: keep one euro price
inner.body: papermark lists plausible at €9 a month. the same page prices proton mail business at $7.99 in one place and $12.99 in another. two prices on your site and an assistant can quote either.

inner.title: audit your listing
inner.body: european-alternatives.eu lets anyone suggest a product with an account and describes no review. papermark says all 100 tools are eu, eea or swiss, then includes three uk ones. check how you're listed.
